verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs explicitly state it was 'designed from the ground up with self-hosting in mind,' runnable via Docker on any OS, with one-click marketplace deployment and full control over data location, and community evidence corroborates a genuinely usable self-hosted experience (praised self-hosting guide). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of feature parity between cloud and self-hosted for AI-specific features (e.g., AI/embeddings modules).
